Mission Local reported that a 16-year-old spent nearly three weeks in San Francisco County Jail after officials initially treated him as an adult, despite being alerted that he might be a minor. He was kept apart from adult inmates in C Pod while the city reviewed evidence of his age. A judge ultimately found he was 16 and ordered him transferred to juvenile hall on $10,000 bail. The story said he had allegedly given law enforcement a false name and birthday.
